sections.Profile:
Supersonic, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine themed around supersonic flight, notably featuring artwork inspired by the Concorde aircraft. The game is designed for single-player action and includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Travel, 1970s, History, Single level playfield
